tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ README and daemon agree on q= with embeddings unavailable; live scratch probe and targeted RETR-002 test prove explicit degraded keyword-only response or fail-closed 503; no silent 200.: README.md:459 and README.md:487 both state: embeddings unavailable + keyword index available -> HTTP 200 with keyword-only results plus explicit `degraded: {"mode":"keyword-only","reason":"..."}`; both legs unavailable -> fail-closed HTTP 503 `EMBEDDINGS_UNAVAILABLE`. Daemon agrees: src/mcp/tools/recall.ts:1097 (semantic-leg failure in hybrid mode) and :1211 (no provider / embed failure) attach `degraded: {mode:"keyword-only", reason}`; src/http/routes/memories.ts:580 forwards it into the REST envelope (`...(result.degraded ? { degraded: result.degraded } : {})`) and :533 maps both-legs-down to 503 via throwRecallError/isEmbeddingsDownError (:53-68); type declared at src/http/types/api.ts:277. Targeted RETR-002 test src/http/routes/memories-hybrid-retr002.test.ts:479-482 asserts `body.degraded` mode keyword-only + reason, and the sibling test asserts 503 EMBEDDINGS_UNAVAILABLE. Test runs (fresh): `npx vitest run src/http/routes/memories-hybrid-retr002.test.ts` -> exit_code 0, 'Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 9 passed (9)'; broader `npx vitest run src/http/routes/memories src/mcp/tools/recall` -> exit_code 0, 'Test Files 29 passed (29) / Tests 196 passed (196)'. Live scratch probe (scratch config dir, DUCKBRAIN_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=none, port 3912): GET /api/memories?namespace=default&q=kbox-01 -> 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK' with body ending `"degraded":{"mode":"keyword-only","reason":"Semantic search requires an embedding provider - start LM Studio/Ollama or set DUCKBRAIN_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER, then run 'duckbrain embeddings rebuild'"}`. Fail-closed probe (port 3913, .search sidecar removed): 'HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable' with `{"error":"Semantic search requires an embedding provider ...","code":"EMBEDDINGS_UNAVAILABLE"}`. No silent 200 observed on either path.
README and daemon now agree on the ?q= degraded contract, proven by a passing RETR-002 test (9/9, exit 0) and live scratch probes showing an explicit 200+degraded keyword-only marker and a fail-closed 503 EMBEDDINGS_UNAVAILABLE.
